context: Kenji stops at the café before work; Aoi recognizes him as a semi-regular and they exchange a small unplanned moment.
purpose: small recognition — the dignity of being remembered by a stranger who serves you

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Soft dreamy barista morning greeting, artist-soft register warming the brisk morning air, gentle hospitality throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おはようございます。アメリカーノ一つお願いします。
lines.style: Earnest salaryman politeness, morning steadiness in the voice, courteous order delivered with calm formality.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あ、いつも同じですね。覚えました。
lines.en: Oh, it's always the same. I remembered.
lines.style: Soft barista pleased observation, the noticing gentle and unforced, dreamy warmth lifting on the recognition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: え、本当ですか。嬉しいですね。
lines.en: Oh, really? That makes me happy.
lines.style: Salaryman warm surprised pleasure, the formal register loosening with genuine touched response, soft real emotion threaded.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Barista gentle dreamy inquiry, casual interest in the regular customer's rhythm, soft attentive curiosity throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、これ飲んでから出勤です。
lines.en: Yes, I head to work after drinking this.
lines.style: Earnest salaryman casual sharing, the daily routine offered with mild self-deprecation about its predictability.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: じゃあ、今日も頑張ってくださいね。
lines.en: Then, please do your best today too.
lines.style: Soft dreamy barista send-off, the small encouragement landing with genuine artist-warm care for the moment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。行ってきます。
lines.style: Salaryman quietly buoyed, voice slightly lighter than entry, the small recognition having genuinely lifted him.
